tasks.label: cmake-configure-release
tasks.command: rm -f CMakeCache.txt && rm -rf build CMakeFiles && mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DUSE_ALL_GFs=OFF ..

tasks.label: cmake-configure-debug
tasks.command: rm -f CMakeCache.txt && rm -rf build_debug CMakeFiles && mkdir -p build_debug && cd build_debug && cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DUSE_ALL_GFs=OFF ..

tasks.label: clean-all
tasks.command: rm -f CMakeCache.txt && rm -rf build build_debug CMakeFiles
